ashley: Heads-up — deploy-bot preflight scheduled for tenant rekey + IAM cutover in quiet change window starting 03:00 UTC. This will touch iam/service-accounts and kms key-change. Please ack availability and own rollback if you're oncall.
jonas: Ack. I'll watch. Can you confirm the canary sequence?
ashley: Canary plan: staging-2 -> beta -> prod-0. 15m observation per stage, auto-rollback threshold 5% 5xx or auth errors. We'll pin provider + tf version for the run.
kevin: What about KMS key rotation? Any downtime risk for consumers?
ashley: KMS rekey is key alias swap; no data re-encryption. Consumers must re-fetch creds within 2 min. We'll keep old key enabled for 1h as escape hatch.
deploy-bot: Preflight started by @ashley
deploy-bot: terraform workspace: prod
deploy-bot: state lock: free
deploy-bot: plan hash: ab12...; changed resources: 6 add, 2 modify, 0 destroy
ashley: Attaching quick rollback playbook snippet — keep it handy:
ashley: ```
# rollback steps
1) cancel deploy-bot run: `deploy-bot cancel 5112346789`
2) revert PR: `git revert <change-commit>` and push
3) run `terraform apply -var-file=prod.pin.tfvars` from release tag v2026.04
4) if tfstate drift -> restore from snapshot: `aws s3 cp s3://tfstate-backups/prod-2026-04-12.tfstate ./terraform.tfstate` and retry
```
sre-oncall: Ack. I'll be ready to trigger snapshot restore.
jonas: Note: will throttle churn on iam bindings — set TF_PARALLELISM=1 during apply
ashley: Good call — set TF_PARALLELISM=1 and export AWS_PROFILE=infra-deploy
kevin: One more: make sure service-account tokens are reissued via ops tool after key swap. I'll handle.
